name: IBANforge
description: Check the bank behind an IBAN before you pay: validation in 89 countries, a bank-code verdict from the national register (DE, AT, BE, SK, CZ, BG, CH, LI), the bank and BIC with their source, SEPA and VoP readiness from the EPC registers where they list the bank, and bank-level sanctions (OFAC, EU, UN). It does not check the payee's name. BIC directory: GLEIF and national registers, refreshed monthly, plus a public copy of the SWIFT directory frozen in January 2018 that still makes up about two thirds of the rows. 900+ non-bank issuer classifications (EMI, payment institutions, digital banks). Card payment (prepaid packs, Pro) or x402 pay-per-call in USDC.

endpoints.description: Validate single IBAN with the bank-code verdict (national register in DE, AT, BE, SK, CZ, BG, CH, LI), BIC lookup with its source, SEPA data, issuer classification
Validate up to 100 IBANs in one call
Lookup BIC/SWIFT code with LEI enrichment

Pre-payment triage of the bank behind an IBAN: validation + sanctions lists (OFAC, EU, UN) matched on the payee's bank (BIC8), the country checked against a fixed list of sanctioned jurisdictions, never the payee's name + FATF status + SEPA Instant reachability + VoP readiness of the bank + risk score (0-100)
Swiss BC-Nummer / IID clearing lookup with SIC, euroSIC, Instant Payments and QR-IID data (1,100+ SIX entries, refreshed monthly)

free_endpoints.description: Free IBAN format check (mod-97 + country structure), no auth
Free IBAN structural templates per country, no auth
Free structured payment reference validation (RF/ISO 11649, Swiss QRR, OGM/VCS, viitenumero), no auth
Free ISO 20022 postal address conformity check (sps, hvps_plus, fedwire), no auth
Free demo with example IBAN/BIC validations
Free list of prepaid credit bundles
Free device authorization request (RFC 8628) — a human approves in a browser
Free collection of the approved key, long-polling, handed over exactly once

api_key.signup: POST /v1/keys/generate with no body at all — no e-mail required
api_key.signup_with_email: POST /v1/keys/generate with body {"email":"you@company.com"} — optional. Never send an address your human has not handed you for this purpose.
api_key.claim: POST /v1/keys/claim, key in the Authorization header — a mailed 6-digit code gives the full allowance every month, an x402 payment on the key gives it once
